headword: {一目瞭然|いちもくりょうぜん}

definitions.gloss: obvious at a glance, crystal clear
definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom meaning something is so clear that it can be understood immediately upon seeing it.

examples.japanese: ⟦グラフ→グラフ：04864_gurafu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一目瞭然|いちもくりょうぜん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The results are obvious at a glance when you look at the graph.

examples.japanese: ⟦{差|さ}→差：02771_sa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一目瞭然|いちもくりょうぜん}で、⟦{説明|せつめい}→説明：01449_setsumei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: The difference is crystal clear; no explanation is needed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{比|くら}べれば→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧⟦{変化|へんか}→変化：03615_henka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{一目瞭然|いちもくりょうぜん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The change is obvious at a glance when you compare the photos.

notes:
FOUR-CHARACTER IDIOM (⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧)

LITERAL MEANING: {一目|いちもく} (one glance) + {瞭然|りょうぜん} (clear, obvious) = Clear with one glance.

FORMS:
- {一目瞭然|いちもくりょうぜん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (predicative)
- {一目瞭然|いちもくりょうぜん}⟦な→な：09497_na⟧＋noun (attributive - less common)
- {一目瞭然|いちもくりょうぜん}で (adverbial)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{一目瞭然|いちもくりょうぜん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (~ is obvious at a glance)
- ⟦{見|み}れば→見る：00283_miru⟧{一目瞭然|いちもくりょうぜん} (obvious once you look)
- ⟦{比|くら}べれば→比べる：01237_kuraberu⟧{一目瞭然|いちもくりょうぜん} (obvious when compared)

ALTERNATIVE READING: Sometimes read as いちもくりょうねん, but いちもくりょうぜん is standard.

ENGLISH EQUIVALENTS:
- Crystal clear
- Plain as day
- Self-evident
